issues.description: Framebuffer base label is inconsistent and makes the reference solution fail to assemble: the problem statement and template define/require the screen buffer base symbol `display_start`, but the solution declares the buffer as `screen_buffer` and still uses `display_start` in address calculations. Since `display_start` is not declared in the solution file, NASM will error on the undefined symbol.
issues.suggestedFix: Use one consistent symbol name for the framebuffer base. E.g., in solution_repository/pixel.asm rename `screen_buffer` to `display_start` (line 5), or alternatively change all solution references from `display_start` to `screen_buffer` (lines 29 and 94) and update the template/problem statement accordingly.
